editorial.blurb: Leña Brava is a hidden gem where exceptional service, creative cocktails, and boldly flavored Mexican dishes come together to create unforgettable celebrations.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive during happy hour to enjoy the bar experience, and don't miss the roasted oysters and empanada with poblano crema—ask your server (like Marta) for menu guidance on timing your courses for the smoothest flow.
